interpretation.summary: Photosynthetic Paulinella evolved chromatophores through a separate primary cyanobacterial endosymbiosis from the one ancestral to Archaeplastida plastids.
interpretation.host: Rhizarian amoeba in the Paulinella lineage
interpretation.endosymbiont: Cyanobacterium related to the Synechococcus–Prochlorococcus group
interpretation.time: Estimates vary substantially; do not hard-code a single acquisition date.
interpretation.ancestryRule: No phylogenetic descent edge connects Paulinella chromatophores to Archaeplastida plastids. Similar process is not common plastid ancestry.
evidence: Reductions in chromatophore genome relative to free-living cyanobacteria
Cell cycle and chromatophore inheritance coordinated

references.title: Genomics-Informed Insights into Endosymbiotic Organelle Evolution in Photosynthetic Eukaryotes
